name: thruster_conns
title: Thruster connectors
purpose: The eight thrusters' harness connectors: two valve coils and two catalyst-bed heater elements each

sources.title: JST GH connector catalogue page (eGH.pdf)
sources.read: ratings and the SM06B-GHS-TB part table (read for the bus_connectors block)

sources.title: Nammo MHT-1N monopropellant hydrazine thruster datasheet (2021)
sources.licence: Nammo datasheet; link and quotes only

parts.quote: jstgh: "Current rating: 1.0 A AC/DC（AWG #26）", part "SM06B-GHS-TB". nammo: "Flow Control Valve Dual in-line, series redundant solenoid valve", "Valve Power 3.5 W-4.1 W @ 28 Vdc and 20°C [per coil]" (0.15 A), "Catalyst Bed Heater Power 5.5 W-6 W per element at 28 Vdc" (0.21 A), "Dual Redundancy Heater". Pins ours: 1 valve supply (armed 28 V), 2 coil A return, 3 coil B return, 4 heater supply (28 V), 5 heater A return, 6 heater B return; mounting pins to ground

layout.rules: along the board edge, cables leaving outward

open_questions: A flight harness would use a qualified connector (e.g. Micro-D); the GH stands in for the design. Its voltage rating not read.
Pin 1 carries both coils' supply (0.3 A) and pin 4 both heater elements (0.42 A), inside the GH's 1.0 A per pin.
